text:
Which statement about the Milky Way is correct?
A
It is a galaxy.
B
It is a group of galaxies.
C
It is a group of stars outside our own galaxy.
D
It is a group of stars which are part of our galaxy.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a group of galaxies.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a group of stars outside our own galaxy.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a group of stars which are part of our galaxy.
